story.title: The Applause Inheritance
story.logline: A musician inherits the roaring cheers of his late grandfather, only to realize the stadium noise is draining living souls.
story.theme: The hidden human cost of public adoration.
story.twist: The roaring crowds in his head are actually the trapped lifeforce of every fan who ever clapped for him.
story.ending: Are you cheering for the music, or are you just waiting to take my place?

scenes.narration: My grandfather died on stage to deafening applause, and now that exact same roar echoes inside my empty skull.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, wearing a worn black leather jacket, standing in a quiet, sterile bedroom with hands over his ears.
scenes.camera: Extreme close-up on face, slow push in

scenes.narration: I grabbed my battered acoustic guitar, desperate to drown out the phantom cheers filling every single waking second of my day.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, sitting on a messy bed strumming a scratched wooden acoustic guitar.

scenes.narration: The moment my fingers hit the strings, the phantom noise swells into a massive stadium wave of screaming, adoring fans.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, closing his eyes tightly as harsh yellow stage lights suddenly flash in his bedroom.
scenes.camera: Rapid zoom in on his face

scenes.narration: I played a tiny coffee shop downtown, and for three minutes, real people clapped. The invisible roar instantly vanished.
scenes.visual_prompt: Wide shot of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, performing on a small wooden stage in a cozy, dimly lit cafe.
scenes.camera: Static wide shot, slight lens flare

scenes.narration: Then the cafe doors slammed shut, and the real patrons slumped into their chairs, staring blankly with completely empty, glass eyes.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of coffee shop customers sitting still like statues, heads drooping, faces pale and expressionless, while Leo watches in absolute horror.

scenes.narration: I checked my grandfather's old leather notebook, finding a dark secret scribbled in the margins of every single winning song.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, flipping through yellowed paper covered in frantic handwriting under a single desk lamp.

scenes.narration: Applause isn't a reward for good art. It's a heavy tax paid in the stolen breath of everyone listening.
scenes.visual_prompt: Close-up of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, staring wide-eyed at the notebook text reflecting in his terrified pupils.

scenes.narration: My phone buzzed with a million new streams, and the stadium roar inside my head grew deafening, tearing my thoughts apart.
scenes.visual_prompt: Medium shot of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, dropping his glowing smartphone as he clutches his head in agonizing pain.

scenes.narration: Outside my window, thousands of fans gather in the street, clapping frantically in unison while their color drains away.
scenes.visual_prompt: High angle shot through a dusty window of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, looking down at a gray crowd clapping silently below.
scenes.camera: High angle looking down, slow zoom out

scenes.narration: You are all screaming your lungs out for my next hit, but are you cheering, or just waiting to vanish?
scenes.visual_prompt: Extreme close-up of Leo, 22, messy dark curly hair, black leather jacket, staring directly down the camera lens with dead, haunted eyes.
scenes.camera: Locked-off macro shot, pulsing red light

caption.hook: The applause sounds like love. It's not.
caption.title: The Applause Inheritance
caption.caption:
Every standing ovation is a silent transaction. He wanted the roaring crowds of his grandfather's legacy, but the cheers echo with something far darker.

What are you willing to sacrifice for a lifetime of applause?
